literal: He does not leave anger, he is without self-control; always, everywhere, to anyone, he is easy.
translation: One who never lets go of anger and lacks self-control is an easy target for anyone to defeat, at any time and in any place.
modern: கோபத்தை விடாதவனும், மனக்கட்டுப்பாடு இல்லாதவனும் ஆகிய ஒருவனை எந்த நேரத்திலும், எந்த இடத்திலும், எவரும் எளிதாக வென்றுவிடலாம்.
explanation: This couplet describes the extreme vulnerability of a person who is consumed by anger and lacks self-restraint. The words 'எஞ்ஞான்றும்' (always) and 'யாங்கணும்' (everywhere) emphasize that such a person has no safe haven or moment of security. Because their own internal flaws constantly weaken them, they become an easy target ('எளிது') for any enemy to overcome.
